changes: Created docs/requirements/decisions/test-runner-consolidation-plan.md (211 lines, 6 H2 sections) as the A0 (kickoff/decision-only) story for Proposal #2 (test runner consolidation). Records the chosen architecture (Path B: in-house parallel runner + manifest + c8 coverage), rejecting Path A (vitest migration of 151 spawn-CLI integration smokes) and Path C (B minus c8). Decomposes implementation into 4 follow-up Lattice stories: B1 runner skeleton + manifest format + test:all entry, B2 collapse 258 test:* scripts into manifest entries, B3 c8 coverage + test:coverage entry, B4 (optional) tag/select UX improvements. Each follow-up has a one-paragraph Scope: + Acceptance: sketch quotable verbatim by future story_create calls.
usage: This decision document is read by future contributors evaluating the test infrastructure direction. It is NOT gate-consumed; it is a one-time architectural commit. B1 should be the next Lattice story after B-35aa is DONE; B2 and B3 follow B1; B4 is optional polish.

actualTranscript: All 16 gates re-verified live by delivery reviewer: file exists; 211 lines; 6 H2 sections (>=4 required); pinned numbers present (151:2 hits, 70,280:1, 258:4, 49:1); Path A/B/C all named, B marked *(chosen)*; B1/B2/B3/B4 present (4 ### headers); testing-infra.md referenced 6x; git diff against testing-infra.md/testing-completeness.md empty; git diff against packages/script/package.json empty; lattice validate PASS 22/22; 4 review lanes all PASS (docs RP-001 + test-coverage round-2 RP-002 + concept RP-003 + quality RP-004); 2 findings raised (F-001 + F-002 evidence-correspondence, B-d7ef pattern recurring) and both resolved after evidence helper re-recorded with intent-specific commands; delivery-check signed at 1384bbc.
outcomeDiff: No gap. Decision doc delivered with required structure; zero side-effects on existing decisions or code.
limitations: Bounded scope by design: A0 is decision-only. The actual runner code (B1), npm script collapse (B2), c8 wiring (B3), and UX polish (B4) are deferred to follow-up Lattice stories per the decision doc's Follow-up section.
pitfalls: B-d7ef evidence-correspondence pattern recurred AGAIN here: my evidence helper bound 6 distinct intents (4 number pins, B1-B4 check, byte-identical guard) all to the same generic grep -c '^## ' command. Test-coverage reviewer caught it in round 1 (F-001/F-002 high). Lesson is now thrice-confirmed: NEVER use a generic fallback grep command for evidence; bind each intent literally to the specific command from its description. The B-d7ef memory note should be updated to make this 'fail-loud' (the helper should refuse to record if the intent text doesn't contain a recognizable command pattern). Also: INIT reviewer went 3 rounds (INIT-001 'A0' undefined; INIT-003 wrong test:* count of 111 only vs 258 total; INIT-004 testing-infra.md overclaim 'dist-black-box-smoke architecture') — for decision docs especially, fact accuracy at INIT matters more than for refactor stories because the doc IS the deliverable.
